response.justification: While Bogdan is a skilled senior software engineer with 16+ years of experience, he critically lacks the mandatory requirements for this role. He has only ~6 months of C++ development experience (at National Instruments) versus the required 5-10 years, no demonstrated Windows platform specialization or SQL Server/Oracle expertise, and minimal capital markets domain exposure (one tangential fintech role at RIDE Capital). His career has focused on web systems and TypeScript development rather than the capital markets C++ systems this role requires.
strengths: 16+ years of senior-level software engineering experience with proven leadership ability
Strong CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure knowledge with hands-on DevOps experience
Excellent communication skills demonstrated through technical talks, workshops, and community engagement
concerns: Only ~6 months of C++ experience versus 5-10 years mandatory requirement
No capital markets, fixed income, or derivatives domain expertise
Career focused on web/TypeScript and Linux systems, lacking Windows C++ platform specialization and SQL Server/Oracle expertise

key_factors.factor: Senior-level engineering capability and communication skills
